description: Applies one operation to a GeoJSON (buffer, simplify, centroid, bbox, convex_hull or clean) and returns the resulting GeoJSON. To measure areas or lengths use measure_geojson, and to change the CRS use reproject_geojson. Takes up to 50,000 features and 200,000 vertices and 1 MiB of arguments, and buffer takes up to 1,000 features and 4,000 vertices (5,000 and 20,000 with max_seconds over 3). Costs US$0.001 per unit (up to 1,000 features and 10,000 vertices) from prepaid credits; with the default 3 s it is charged only when it succeeds, and invalid input is never charged. Set dry_run to true to get the price without charging and max_cost_usd to refuse a call that would cost more; for heavier inputs set max_seconds from 4 to 30, where each second over the 3 included costs US$0.0005, the full time is held up front and the unused part refunded, and the price and the time used are charged if the call runs out of time or memory, or is cancelled while running.

inputSchema.description: Apply one geometric operation to a GeoJSON and return the resulting GeoJSON.

distance_m.description: Buffer distance in meters (0 to 100000). Required for buffer. Buffer accepts at most 1,000 features, 4,000 vertices and 1,000 MultiPoint positions; with max_seconds above 3 (extended time), 5,000 features, 20,000 vertices and 5,000 MultiPoint positions.

dry_run.description: When true, return the price (cost_usd) and units of this call without running it or charging anything.

geojson.description: GeoJSON object: a FeatureCollection, a Feature or a bare geometry, in WGS84 longitude/latitude unless a CRS is stated. Limits: 50,000 features and 200,000 vertices. An operation that runs past its compute or memory limit fails with 422 operation_too_complex or operation_too_large.

max_cost_usd.description: The most this call may cost, in USD, as a number or decimal text with at most 6 decimals (e.g. 0.01 or "0.01"). A call that would cost more is refused with 402 max_cost_exceeded and nothing is charged.

max_seconds.description: Compute time limit in seconds, 1 to 30 (default 3; 1 to 3 all use the standard 3 s). The price includes 3 s of compute. From 4 to 30 (extended time) the call runs on a separate lane, where buffer accepts larger inputs, and each second over 3 costs the geo_compute_second price: the price plus all those seconds is held at the start (that is what dry_run reports and max_cost_usd is compared with), the seconds not used are refunded, and the response adds compute_ms and max_seconds. With extended time the price and the time used are charged if the call runs out of time or memory, or is cancelled while running: 422 operation_too_complex keeps the whole hold, 422 operation_too_large or 413 result_too_large (a result over 8 MiB) or 499 cancelled keep the price and the seconds used, and those errors carry cost_usd. Any other failure is refunded in full.

operation.description: Operation: buffer, simplify, centroid, bbox, convex_hull, or clean (drops point features with empty, non-numeric, swapped, out-of-range or 0,0 coordinates).

tolerance_m.description: Simplify tolerance in meters, converted to degrees approximately (1 degree is about 111,320 m), so it is less exact away from the equator. Defaults to 10.

name: transform_geojson

balance_usd.description: Credit balance after the charge, US dollars as decimal text; absent with dry_run.

call_id.description: Server-issued id of the call; absent with dry_run.

compute_ms.description: Extended time only: the compute time the call was billed on, in milliseconds.

cost_usd.description: What the call cost (or would cost, with dry_run), US dollars as decimal text.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was run or charged.

max_seconds.description: Extended time only: the max_seconds the call ran (or would run) with.

result.description: The operation's result; absent with dry_run.
